headline: Food price cuts were arranged by our minister, boasts Okamura. It's not true, economists respond - Novinky
summary: SPD leader Tomio Okamura credited a drop in food prices this year to agriculture minister Martin Šebestyán. Economists said the decline is mainly due to European market developments, cheaper inputs and high supply.
why: Food prices feed directly into consumer inflation, which shapes central bank policy and household spending in the Czech Republic.
